subject: Airflow Meetup in Warsaw on 21st of May!

messages.subject: Airflow Meetup in Warsaw on 21st of May!
messages.body:
Hi all.

On 21st of May there will be another Airflow meetup at the Google office in
Warsaw.
The meetup will be held in the hybrid mode: you are welcome to visit Google
Warsaw office or you can join it via Google meet live.
Link to the event on meetup:
https://www.meetup.com/warsaw-apache-airflow-meetup-group/events/314673968/
Linkedin event:
https://www.linkedin.com/posts/eugene-kostieiev-36553150_welcome-to-the-apache-airflow-community-meetup-activity-7458453367875354625-N4VM?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop&rcm=ACoAAArBt70BLj3atvDr33WrWFFPpFpZTdCW2Kk

*When: *May 21, 6:15 PM to 9:15 PM CET
*Sign up: *
https://www.meetup.com/warsaw-apache-airflow-meetup-group/events/314673968/

At "Apache Airflow Meetup @ Google Warsaw" we will talk about Airflow 3,
its features, how to migrate from Airflow 2 to Airflow 3 and also how AI
Tools help Airflow Maintainers!

*Preliminary agenda:*
- 18:15 - 19:45 session block 1
*“What's New in Airflow 3”* - Eugene Kostieiev
*"Migration from Airflow 2 to Airflow 3"* - Tomasz Żukowski
- 19:45 - 20:15 snacks & networking
- 20:15 - 20:45 session block 2
*“Less Triage, Less Code, More English: A Quarter of Building AI Tools for
the Airflow Maintainers”* - Jarek Potiuk (PMC member of Apache Airflow)

I encourage you to come and discuss Airflow development with other users,
developers and passionates.
If you want to participate in person, please make sure to register with
your full name, in order to be registered with the office security.
Event will also will be streamed live: https://meet.google.com/xyv-rdtv-hps

If you have any interesting topic to talk about, please, reach out to me to
discuss the possibility of including it in the agenda.

Best,
Eugene Kostieiev
